{{Quote|Silas Jarrde. I'm in charge of the local resistance here. We're going to take back the Balmorran Arms Factory or die trying.|Silas Jarrde|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Silas Jarrde''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] who led a resistance cell in the [[Sundari Flatlands]] during the later stages of the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|fighting]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Though he was skeptical of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] willingness to help the resistance, he recruited Republic aid in sabotaging the sensor array serving the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silas Jarrde starts the mission "Critical Sabotage" for Republic players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
